name: Wellmed Arm Digital Blood Pressure Monitor BP Machine ( Without Battery )
description:
Wellmed Arm Digital Blood Pressure Monitor (BP Machine)

Monitor your health with ease using the Wellmed Arm Digital Blood Pressure Monitor – designed for accurate and convenient blood pressure and pulse measurements.

Key Features:

Intelligent Automatic Measurement: Accurate readings with one-button operation.

WHO Classification: Provides readings based on World Health Organization standards.

Large LCD Display: Clear, backlit screen showing blood pressure, pulse rate, date, and time.

Memory Function: Stores up to 2×99 measurements for tracking your health over time.

Universal Cuff: Fits arms with a circumference of 6.5″–8.7″.

Compact & Portable: Sleek design suitable for home, office, or clinical use; easy to carry and store.

Voice Feature: Intelligent voice prompts for easier reading and operation.

Origin: China

Reliable, easy-to-use, and compact – perfect for daily monitoring of blood pressure and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
